snip.t: Uraemic Symptoms: If severe uraemia is present (e.g., pericarditis, encephalopathy, severe nausea/vomiting), urgent dialysis is indicated.
*Elimination:* Loop diuretics (furosemide) if urine output is preserved; gastrointestinal cation exchangers; emergency haemodialysis if refractory, anuric, or associated with severe uraemia/acidosis.
| Endocrine and metabolic | Hyperthyroidism, Cushing's syndrome, uraemia, B12 or folate deficiency |

The minor criteria include a respiratory rate of 30 or more (increased), PaO2/FiO2 of 250 or less, multilobar infiltrates, confusion, uraemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, hypothermia and hypotension.
